changes.rationale: March 23 US-dated joint release announces Takeda licenses to ADC technology for up to two targets, with $20 million upfront. Japan dateline is March 24. Agreement execution on March 20 is distinct from announcement; exact release time and earlier-public completeness remain unverified.

May 18 issuer release announces global Janssen collaboration and license for preclinical MGD015, with $75 million upfront subject to closing conditions. June 28 closing is a separate event. Exact release time and earlier-public completeness remain unverified.

January 23 issuer release announces worldwide encorafenib rights from Novartis, including patent assignment/license, development funding and transition services; class 6 rights-transfer arrangement. Release schedules a 9 a.m. ET call. Deal remains conditional; this is not regulatory approval or acquisition of Array. Historical Array BioPharma CIK 1100412 must not be replaced by the modern ARRY issuer. Exact release time and earlier-public completeness remain unverified.
